title: Finite torsion-free abelian groups have finite bases
statement: Let $G$ be a finitely generated torsion-free abelian group. Then there are $r\in\mathbf N$ and elements $e_1,\ldots,e_r\in G$ such that every element of $G$ has a unique expression $\sum_i n_i e_i$ with $n_i\in\mathbf Z$.

source.place: Expose VI, 3.7(a), printed p. 75; the assertion that the finitely generated torsion-free group $Q^{\rm gp}$ admits a finite basis.
